description: Replace the open project with a new, empty one (one scene, one shot with the style's start place, light and lead character). The first call only says what will happen; ask the person, then call again with confirm: true. The person can Undo it right after. To keep the project and only change its look, use set_style; to open a saved file, use open_project. Returns the new scene and shot ids.

confirm.description: true only after the person said yes.

format.description: horizontal 16:9 or vertical 9:16. Left out: the current format.

style.description: Style id from list_styles, like pixel, toon, voxel, docu. Left out: the current style.

name: new_project
